definition: Enables the transfer of prostaglandins from one side of a membrane to the other. A prostaglandin is any of a group of biologically active metabolites which contain a cyclopentane ring due to the formation of a bond between two carbons of a fatty acid. They have a wide range of biological activities.
label: 5-oxo-EPA, 15d-PGJ3 translocate from cytosol to extracellular region
